How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Indore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Indore is 22-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD or equivalent degree in relevant branches of Engineering/Technology with a first division in their previous academic degrees.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000 per month, plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How will the selection process be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and then invited for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official IIT Indore website.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Indore offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or relaxation details. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for this information.

faq.question: Q9. When is the tentative date for the online interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the online interview is 24-08-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article, once released.
